 Per Court :-

The applicant is seeking pre-arrest bail in  connection with Crime No.123/2014 registered at  Georai Police Station, District Beed for the offences  punishable under sections 272, 273, 179, 328 of IPC  and u/s 3 (1) )(zz) (v), 26 (z) of the Food Safety and  Standards Act, 2006.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits  that the except the statement of the co-accused, there is  no other connecting evidence as against the applicant.
His antecedents are clear.

sentences.text:
However, the applicant has not filed any application,
 but the charge sheet has been submitted and except the  evidence as aforesaid, there is no connecting evidence  as against the applicant.
2. I have also heard the learned APP for the  respondent State.
3. On perusal of the investigation papers, it  appears that except confessional statement of the co-  accused, there is no connecting evidence against the  applicant.
It further appears from the charge-sheet that  even contraband articles were not sent for CA purpose.

Even though the applicant has not filed an application  for confirmation of the said order dated 17.12.2014 in Kailas Balkisan Loya vs The State Of Maharashtra on 15 February, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184683991/

sentences.text: 2  aaa/-

::: Uploaded on - 15/02/2019 ::: Downloaded on - 16/02/2019 04:1  3 ABA 119.2019.odt  Criminal application no.5990/2014, considering the  entire aspect of the case, I am inclined to grant pre-  arrest bail to the present applicant.
Hence, following  order.
ORDER 1. Application is hereby allowed.

2. In the event of arrest of the applicant Kailas Balkisan Loya in connection with Crime No.123/2014 registered at Georai Police Station, District Beed for the offences punishable under sections 272,
273, 179, 328 of IPC and u/s 3 (1) )(zz) (v), 26 (z) (I) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he be released on bail on his furnishing P.B. of Rs.15,000/- (Rs. Fifteen thousand) with one surety of the like amount by on the following conditions :-
a] The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
b] The applicant shall make himself available as and when required by the Investigating agency.
3. Application is accordingly disposed of.
( V.K. JADHAV, J. ) aaa/-
